metadata.description: Roslyn's language server (the engine behind the C# Dev Kit) as a Claude Code plugin, shared across instances.

plugins.name: roslyn
plugins.description: Roslyn C#/VB language server for Claude Code: one shared per-workspace server, analyzer shadow-copying so builds never lock, native .slnx and .NET 10, plus a refactoring MCP (solution-wide rename, code actions, find-references, format) and an extension API for live systems.
